title: Dainty Gold Petite Crystal Solitaire Ring
storyHtml:
The smallest wink of a crystal on a slim beaded band — barely-there sparkle for the days you want to feel put-together in seconds. Made for stacking, made for forgetting you have it on.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
